meta.title: Recreate Order is offered on an RFQ that has been awarded

plan.title: Recreate Order available on awarded RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded event's summary page without creating or searching for another event.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where the stage Settings menu is available.
Assert that Recreate Order is offered and enabled in the RFQ Settings menu.
Click Recreate Order to verify the action can be used and leave its window open.
Assert that selecting Recreate Order opens its window before any confirmation changes the event.
Cancel the Recreate Order window so no order is recreated.
Assert that the Recreate Order window closes after cancellation.
